import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=np.asarray(t); P=np.asarray(P); y=np.asarray(dP_dt)
S=np.sum((y-y.mean())**2)
def run(model,p0,n=12):
    best=None; rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
    for trial in range(n):
        p=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.3*rng.standard_normal(len(p0))) if trial else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            s=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-y, p, max_nfev=4000)
            if best is None or s.cost<best.cost: best=s
        except Exception: pass
    return round(1-2*best.cost/S,6), np.round(best.x,4)
